title: MASSIVE BOMBSHELL: RFK Jr. Says Biden Admin COLLABORATED In Child Trafficking (For S*x and Sl*very!)
text:
I know some people don’t like it when we use “foul language” around here, but as President Trump famously once told Franklin Graham, sometimes no other word will do.
So I think BioClandestine is right with his caption on this stunning clip from RFK Jr…..
HOLY SHIT!
RFK Jr. just said point blank that (1) the Dept. of HHS under the Biden Regime collaborated in child trafficking, both for sex and for slavery, and (2) there are 300,000 missing children that they are desperately trying to find.
Absolutely stunning and truly crimes against humanity!
Watch here:
HOLY SHIT…
RFK Jr. says HHS was a “collaborator in child trafficking”, and that he has ended this and now they are aggressively trying to find these “300,000 children that were lost by the Biden administration”.
You thought Russiagate and Covid were bad?
Tip of the iceberg. pic.twitter.com/6maLCE6gz8
— Clandestine (@WarClandestine) April 30, 2025
FULL TRANSCRIPT:
We have ended HHS as the role as the vector—
the principal vector in this country for child trafficking.
And during the Biden administration,
HHS became a collaborator in child trafficking—
and for sex and for slavery.
And we have ended that,
and we’re very aggressively going out
and trying to find these children—
the three hundred thousand children
that were lost by the Biden.
Full screen video player here:
RFK JR:
The Biden Administration collaborated in CHILD SEX TRAFFICKING!
BOMBSHELL!!!
Quote:
“We have ended HHS as the role as the vector—
the principal vector in this country for child trafficking.
And during the Biden administration,
HHS became a collaborator in child… pic.twitter.com/NotSovpS3K
— Noah Christopher (@DailyNoahNews) April 30, 2025
This is truly a bombshell to end all bombshells and if individual people are identified and proven in Court or in a Tribunal that they did this, they should be executed on National TV.
Do you agree?
Folks, the information that is going to come out over the next 4 years is going to shock many, and I do not think some people will be able to process it. I think some people may die on the spot from the shock of how many horrible things were happening behind the scenes.
That’s why they’ve been dripping it out as slowly as possible, to try and warm up the public and reduce the shock, but when it all comes out it’s going to be absolutely horrific.
Buckle up.
Was Joe Biden involved?
Was he complicit?
Was he informed?
CRIMES.
AGAINST.
HUMANITY.
Now add in COVID poison, COVID VAXX poison, chemtrails, Fluoride in our Water, poisons in our food, and you start to realize just how psychopathic these people truly are.
Pure evil.
And most never had any idea, just happy to go to their 9-5, do a little grilling on the weekends, watch the NFL on Sunday and live that blue-pill lifestyle. So sad.
